name: Frostsaber Provisions
label: Quest
description: Frostsaber Provisions: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you wish to prove yourself, you may begin by doing a very simple, but very important task.
Gather meat from the chimaera and from the shardtooth bears in the area. Bring it to me so that I may use it to feed the frostsabers that are being trained.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Discipline and determination are your goals. I may ask you to do a simple task many times; you must perform to the best of your ability each time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for assisting me, friend. My opinion of you grows as time passes.
